cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: You Can’t Leave Mid-Prophecy
cards.instruction: Keep someone present until the impossible prediction has been fulfilled, disproved, or responsibly revised.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Stay until sunset. Gran predicted this stone would hatch, and I promised we'd witness the result. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The sun's down. It's still a stone.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Then help me record that it didn't hatch. We can put the prophecy to rest.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll sign, but Gran never said which day.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then stay while we ring her and agree a deadline. I can't witness every sunset alone.

mechanism: A organizes witnessing a stone prophecy, shortens the requested commitment around B objections and needs B to help close or revise it.
confusable: Unlike simply delaying departure, A is willing to record disproof and negotiate a definite prophecy deadline.
comparison: A family promise with an unspecified day differs from a public noon prediction and a fast watch.
seedUse: D146-a stone, Gran, sunset and missing date; S02-a adapts the official plan to retain a witness.
